fact: The government directory's table of district administration office contacts as from 1 March 2025 lists 27 district administration offices (26 districts, Perseverance as two), each with its own office e-mail address on the government's gov.sc domain and an office telephone number; it does not say how the offices are connected or name the Electronic Government Network.
title: Seychelles Government Directory 2025
publisher: Office of the President, State House
